checks.name: Focused final Overview and configuration unit recheck

checks.name: Complete rebuilt production browser suite
checks.command: cd tests/e2e && PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE=/usr/bin/chromium PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/workspace/.playwright WOOBE_CAPTURE_DOCS=1 WOOBE_REQUIRE_GEORGIA=1 npx playwright test --config playwright.config.ts
checks.execution: Complete suite before the final Recent Runs column-width adjustment; affected pages rebuilt and rechecked below.
checks.includes: 11 Overview tests: five widths (320/390/768/1280/1440), selected axe rules, sparse/zero/partial-cost evidence, real-time positions, seven-day filtering, stale-data isolation, refresh failure, configuration blockers and keyboard inspection; existing navigation, routes, cost, embed and typography checks.

checks.command: cd tests/e2e && PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE=/usr/bin/chromium PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/workspace/.playwright WOOBE_CAPTURE_DOCS=1 WOOBE_REQUIRE_GEORGIA=1 npx playwright test --config playwright.config.ts tests/overview-refinement.spec.ts tests/typography.spec.ts tests/surface-coverage.spec.ts --grep "overview|fonts render"
checks.execution: Final source, including Recent Runs columns, with five-width overflow/axe checks and fresh Overview captures/font probes.

checks.name: Page-owned cost coverage and Skill installation dialogs

checks.execution: Rebuilt and exercised by the final production-browser suite.

screenshots.scope: Only main-page screenshots committed. Additional Overview scroll-inspection images remain in ignored browser test artifacts.
screenshots.visual_review: Full-size Overview desktop/tablet/mobile, with scrolled activity, Recent Runs and current-state inspection. Existing charcoal navigation, Georgia headings, Inter labels and mono numerical values retained.

font_roles.interface: Actual custom Inter glyphs, including Overview analysis headings
font_roles.technical: Actual custom JetBrains Mono numerical glyphs

skills: Original frontend-design and guild-inspired-enterprise-ui v2.0 files unchanged.

environment_configuration.publication: Pending user review/save/publish in environment settings; Georgia is installed and verified in the current machine.

remote_ci: Not inspected: api.github.com is outside the current cloud HTTP allowlist.

overview_data_contract.success: Completed / terminal; cancelled included, running excluded. Rates remain backend-owned.
overview_data_contract.duration: Average and p95 over recorded terminal durations.
overview_data_contract.activity: UTC hourly/daily buckets over [from,to); partial edges clipped, missing buckets unavailable, explicit zeros preserved. Summary totals are not inferred from sparse points.
overview_data_contract.cost: Known subtotal, explicit partial coverage and unknown cost retained.
overview_data_contract.comparisons: Only Agent Run volume has previous-window evidence in the current API.
overview_data_contract.configuration: Metadata checks distinguish blockers, unknown, permission and fetch errors; page completeness never grants project readiness.
overview_data_contract.routing: Existing entity/Run routes; generic Run ledger navigation makes no unsupported URL-filter promise.

initial_validation_corrections: Scoped the absolute-count browser assertion to the primary KPI because the same evidence is intentionally repeated in reliability.

An existing credentials flow sent Escape before the revoke dialog received initial focus. The test now waits for the named dialog and focus, and asserts dismissal before reopening; no credential behavior changed.
lint: No lint script is configured in woobe-frontend; TypeScript, Vitest, Playwright and whitespace checks were used.
limits: Synthetic HTTP fixtures do not qualify a live backend or provider deployment.
Selected axe WCAG A/AA rules are not a complete accessibility certification.
System Chromium and local Georgia rasterization may differ on other machines.
